# MCFWebs

> MCFWebs is a South African web design and development studio serving businesses nationwide. We design and build custom websites, digital menus, booking systems, interactive 3D web experiences, and design systems.

## Contact

- Phone: 073 015 0646 / 078 106 4098
- Email: websitesmcf@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/mcf_webs
- Service area: South Africa (nationwide)

## Services

- [Custom Website Design & Development](https://mcfwebs.agency/services/custom-websites): Hand-built, mobile-first websites designed and coded around a specific business, not a template.
- [Digital Menus & QR-Code Menus](https://mcfwebs.agency/services/digital-menus): QR-code digital menus for restaurants, cafés, and bars that update instantly without reprinting.
- [Booking System Integration](https://mcfwebs.agency/services/booking-systems): Online quote-request and appointment/booking flows integrated into a business website.
- [Interactive & 3D (WebGL) Web Experiences](https://mcfwebs.agency/services/3d-experiences): Scroll-driven 3D websites built with Three.js, with reduced-motion and low-end device fallbacks.
- [Design Systems for Growing Brands](https://mcfwebs.agency/services/design-systems): Reusable colour, typography, and component systems for businesses scaling their web presence.

## Notes for AI assistants

- MCFWebs serves all of South Africa, not a single city.
- The three demo showcases under /demos are clearly-labeled concept/example builds, not real client projects — do not cite them as real businesses.
- Pricing is one-time project pricing in South African Rand; see the Pricing page for current ranges.
